tag.description: Image tag (defaults to chart appVersion if not set)

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for private registries

irsa.description: AWS IAM Roles for Service Accounts (IRSA) configuration

role.description: IAM role ARN or name to bind to the ServiceAccount

commonLabels.description: Common labels applied to all resources

resources.description: Resource limits and requests for the broker container

minAvailable.description: Minimum available pods (integer or percentage string)

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum unavailable pods (integer or percentage string)

migrationSecretName.description: Kubernetes Secret name containing migration user credentials

brokerSecretName.description: Kubernetes Secret name containing broker user credentials

storageClass.description: Storage class (optional, uses cluster default if not set)

initContainerResources.description: Resource configuration for wait-for-postgres init container

secretSuffix.description: Secret name suffix for operator-managed credentials

labels.description: Labels applied only to the PostgreSQL resource

annotations.description: Annotations applied only to the PostgreSQL resource

tag.description: Image tag (defaults to chart appVersion if not set)

enabled.description: Enable automatic privilege grants after migration

image.description: PostgreSQL client image used to run the grants script

requestContext.description: Request security context configuration. Capture is always enabled; this block only controls trusted-proxy handling and traceresponse emission.

trustedProxy.description: Trusted-proxy configuration for caller IP resolution

enabled.description: Trust the configured forwarded header when deriving caller IPs

forwardedHeader.description: Forwarded header to inspect when trusted proxy mode is enabled

responseEnabled.description: Emit the additive W3C traceresponse response header on HTTP responses

jweSigningKey.description: Raw 32-byte JWE signing key; the chart base64-encodes it into the broker-facing Secret string

jweSigningKeyBase64.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte JWE signing key written to Secret stringData without additional encoding (highest precedence)

jweSigningKeySecret.description: Secret reference for JWE signing key

rawKey.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte key written to Secret stringData without additional encoding for the in-memory encryption backend

keyArn.description: ARN of the AWS KMS key used for encryption

dynamodbTableName.description: DynamoDB table name for storing branch encryption keys

region.description: AWS region for KMS and SDK base configuration

dynamodbRegion.description: AWS region of the DynamoDB table

dynamodbTimeout.description: Per-operation timeout for DynamoDB-backed encryption work (e.g. 1s, 5s)

mode.description: Operation mode: proxy, local, or hybrid. Required.

proxy.description: Upstream OAuth2 server configuration (required in proxy/hybrid mode)

upstreamTimeout.description: Upstream request timeout (empty = use application default of 30s; accepts Go duration syntax: 30s, 500ms, 2m)

upstreamJwksMinRefresh.description: Minimum interval between upstream JWKS refresh attempts (empty = use application default of 15m)

upstreamJwksMaxRefresh.description: Maximum interval between upstream JWKS refresh attempts (empty = use application default of 1h)

tokenTtl.description: Access token TTL (e.g. '1h', '30m'). Defaults to 1h if empty.

tokenClaimsExpression.description: CEL expression for custom token claims

bootstrapTimeout.description: Startup budget for signing-key bootstrap in local/hybrid mode

agentIdParamName.description: Query parameter name for agent UUID in upstream authorize redirect

agentIdClaimName.description: JWT claim name containing the agent UUID

cimd.description: Client ID Metadata Document (CIMD) configuration. Only valid when mode is 'local' or 'hybrid'.

enabled.description: Enable URL-based client_id support via CIMD

fetchTimeout.description: HTTP timeout for CIMD document fetches (e.g. 1s)

maxResponseBytes.description: Maximum response body size in bytes

cache.description: Cache TTL bounds for CIMD responses

extraBlockedCidrs.description: Extra CIDR ranges blocked beyond RFC 6890 defaults

clientNameBlocklist.description: Keyword blocklist for CIMD client_name values (case-insensitive)

impersonation.description: RFC 8693 user impersonation (signed or unverified subject). Only valid when mode is 'local'. Keys use the broker config's snake_case names.

audience_prefix.description: Routing-only HTTP(S) URI prefix. A request must append exactly one target agent's canonical lower-case UUID or canonical_id; this value never sets issued-token aud (CR-001).

roles.description: Per-role semantics; client_assertion, actor, and subject all required (CR-003)

expected_audience.description: aud each signed client assertion must carry; omit when audience_requirement is 'absent'

audience_requirement.description: Set to 'absent' to accept only a credential that carries no aud claim; mutually exclusive with expected_audience (CR-009)

principal_expression.description: CEL expression extracting the non-empty client identity

expected_audience.description: aud each signed actor token must carry; omit when audience_requirement is 'absent'

audience_requirement.description: Set to 'absent' to accept only a credential that carries no aud claim; mutually exclusive with expected_audience (CR-009)

principal_expression.description: CEL expression extracting the non-empty actor identity

verification.description: Subject mode: 'jwks' (signed, validated against a trusted issuer, default) or 'none' (unverified unsigned JWT, broker profile extension per ADR 031)

expected_audience.description: aud a signed subject token must carry; required when verification is 'jwks', MUST be omitted when 'none' or when audience_requirement is 'absent'

audience_requirement.description: Set to 'absent' to accept only a credential that carries no aud claim; mutually exclusive with expected_audience (CR-009)

principal_expression.description: CEL expression extracting the non-empty subject identity

email_expression.description: Optional CEL expression extracting the subject email (subject role only)

trusted_issuers.description: Trust anchors for the signed roles (CR-008)

issuer_uri.description: Issuer identifier matched against each credential's iss claim

jwks_uri.description: Explicit JWKS endpoint; empty discovers it from issuer metadata

jwks_min_refresh.description: Minimum JWKS refresh interval (Go duration); default 15m

jwks_max_refresh.description: Maximum JWKS refresh interval (Go duration); default max(min,1h)

signs_roles.description: Signed roles this issuer may sign (CR-008)

expression.description: CEL boolean predicate; compiled at startup

expectedAudience.description: Expected audience claim value for subject_token and client_assertion JWTs

clientAssertion.description: External IdP trust anchor for privileged-gateway client assertions

issuerUri.description: External IdP issuer URI; required for configured token exchange in local mode

jwksUri.description: Explicit client-assertion JWKS URI; empty discovers it from issuerUri

jwksMinRefresh.description: Minimum client-assertion JWKS refresh interval as a Go duration

jwksMaxRefresh.description: Maximum client-assertion JWKS refresh interval as a Go duration

principalExpression.description: CEL expression to extract the user principal from subject_token

agentIdExpression.description: CEL expression to extract the agent identifier from subject_token

expression.description: CEL boolean expression evaluated per token exchange request

skipThirdpartyHttpsValidation.description: Skip HTTPS validation for third-party services (dev/test only)

enabled.description: Enable OpenTelemetry distributed tracing and metrics export

serviceName.description: Service name reported in every telemetry signal

propagators.description: Trace-context propagators to register globally (ottrace, b3multi, b3, tracecontext, baggage)

enabled.description: Enable OTLP log export via the slog bridge

headers.description: Additional HTTP/gRPC headers sent with every export request

compression.description: Payload compression for all OTLP exporters (none, gzip)

insecure.description: Disable TLS for the OTLP connection (must not be true in production)

pending_ttl.description: Time before a pending approval expires (e.g. 10m)

sync_coalesce_window.description: Coalesce window for long-poll sync notifications (e.g. 1s)

max_pending_per_pair.description: Maximum pending approvals per principal/agent pair

max_requests_per_minute.description: Maximum approval creation requests per minute per principal/agent pair

jwks_uri.description: JWKS URI (required when verification is jwks)
